run_rake_weighting: run raking on sample and target DataFrames using iterative proportional fitting to compute adjusted survey weights
prepare_marginal_dist_for_raking: create a DataFrame from nested dictionaries of marginal proportions for use as raking target data
realize_dicts_of_proportions: generate equal-length proportional arrays from dictionaries of category proportions using LCM or Hare-Niemeyer allocation
run_ipf_numpy: run iterative proportional fitting on a NumPy array against target marginal distributions with convergence tracking
hare_niemeyer_allocation: allocate slots to categories using the Hare-Niemeyer largest remainder method to avoid rounding bias
